name: Help The Move Partner API
description:
Programmatic interface for agencies that manage branches, landlords, properties,
and tenant moves inside Help The Move. All endpoints follow JSON:API-inspired
conventions and require a partner API token passed via the `Authorization: Bearer`
header. The same contract is deployed to every white-label host listed in the
`servers` section so that integrators can promote the exact same request bodies
across production, clone, and staging environments.
